episodes.synopsis: It's just another ordinary day at school for Miko-chan... Or is it? Between the scary noises, randomly moving objects, and flickering lights, something's just not right. Maybe it's the monsters she sees all around her?
episodes.title: Can You See Them?

episodes.synopsis: Try as she may, Miko sees monsters all around her: lurking in her locker, assaulting her best friend, even at her new favorite donut shop. Only one thing to do: Ignore 'em!
episodes.title: She Totally Sees Them

episodes.synopsis: Miko and Hana go out on the town for a shopping adventure, but there's no escaping those spooky sights! Maybe it's time for an exorcism, or powerful prayer beads?
episodes.title: She Still Sees Them

episodes.synopsis: When Miko's brother Kyouske notices her acting strange, he decides it's only for one reason: she HAS to have a boyfriend! Unbeknownst to him, she's not seeing any guy in particular...
episodes.title: Yep, She Sees Them

episodes.synopsis: Yulia has a secret: she can see spirits all around her, and she's pretty sure Miko can, too! Miko doesn't seem all that interested in revealing her power, though...
episodes.title: She Sees Them, Too

episodes.synopsis: Unlike Miko, Hana has no idea the kind of monsters she attracts. When one real crazy one stars haunting her, however, Miko decides she's got to do something about it!
episodes.title: She Sees Real Crazy Ones

episodes.synopsis: Yulia's determined to get Miko to reveal her true powers to her -- and accept that Yulia's a seer, just like her! Maybe a trip to a haunted tunnel will do the trick?
episodes.title: Did You See That?

episodes.synopsis: There's no such thing as a normal shopping trip, as far as Miko's concerned. Later, a misunderstanding on Miko's part causes her to rethink her non-approach to ghosts.
episodes.title: The Things She Sees

episodes.synopsis: Miko's new homeroom teacher--and his host of ghosts--forces Miko's hand. A trip to a haunted house turns out to be good for Miko's psyche.
episodes.title: Things She's Seen Before

episodes.synopsis: When Hana's hunger spirals out of control, Miko comes to a frightening conclusion about the cause. But how can she help when that same cause makes it impossible for her to focus?
episodes.title: Don't Look

episodes.synopsis: Miko bolsters her resolve and takes action. The horrifying truth behind her teacher's spirits comes to light.
episodes.title: She Looks

episodes.synopsis: After incurring spiritual debt, Miko seeks out her benefactor to show gratitude. Life seems to return to normal for Miko--whatever normal means for her.
episodes.title: The Girl Who Sees
